manifestations.invariant: Key rotation commits as one state transition: if any rewrap callback raises, the active key, every ciphertext, and completed-rotation count remain exactly as they were before the call.

contract_excerpt.quote: A rejected key rotation is observationally absent: if rewrapping any stored secret raises an exception, the active key, every stored ciphertext, and the completed-rotation count all retain their pre-call values.
